document_api_meta.title: Get Engagement Task Performances
document_api_meta.env_desc: Retrieve detailed performance metrics for a customer engagement task, including message reads, order conversions, and other key engagement statistics.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc: Shop_cipher is required for cross-border shops, and optional for local shops. It's unique for each shop. Get the this property from the Get Authorized Shop API dynamically. Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.

request_body_param.name: task_ids
request_body_param.desc: The customer engagement task IDs for which to retrieve performance data. Provide 1 to 50 IDs; each ID must be a base-10 string that fits in a signed 64-bit integer.

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: ^task_performances
response_param.desc: The requested list of task performance.

response_param.name: ^^id
response_param.desc: The customer engagement task ID for this performance record.

response_param.name: ^^status
response_param.desc:
The status of the task.
Possible values:
- `UNKNOWN`: The task status is unknown.
- `DRAFT`: The task is in draft status.
- `WAITING`: The task is waiting.
- `SENDING`: The task is sending messages.
- `FAILED`: The task failed to send messages.
- `CANCELED`: The task was canceled.
- `SUCCESS`: The task completed successfully.
- `DELETED`: The task was deleted.

response_param.name: ^^sent_recipient_count
response_param.desc: The number of users that received the message.

response_param.name: ^^read_recipient_count
response_param.desc: The number of users that read the message.

response_param.name: ^^order_count
response_param.desc: The number of orders resulting from the message.

response_param.name: ^^gmv_amount
response_param.desc: The revenue from the converted orders.
